title: A Gaussian polynomial feature has its actual ambient L² derivative
source_anchor: Samplinglib original feature differentiation and transport supplement v1, 2026-10-21; units[0] and its complete formula proof
target_statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product normed space with its Borel measurable structure, let γ be its centered standard Gaussian law with identity covariance, and let p be any finite real polynomial. For every ambient w and every direction v, both f_w(x)=p(⟨w,x⟩) and d_{w,v}(x)=p′(⟨w,x⟩)⟨v,x⟩ belong to L²(γ). There exist simultaneous membership witnesses and a field D(w):E→L²(γ) of continuous real linear maps such that D(w)v is exactly the class of d_{w,v}. The actual feature-class map Φ(w)=[f_w] is fully Fréchet differentiable at every ambient w, with derivative D(w). No feature membership, derivative membership, domination, differentiability or operator bound is an input.
